Recruit, onboard, certify, and enable partners across Europe, APAC, and Latin America, prioritizing coverage gaps by geography, customer segment, and product line. Serve initially as Esko’s first dedicated channel leader, then build and lead a global team that is expected to include channel managers in APAC and Latin America. Own global indirect bookings performance and create a reliable view of partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, revenue contribution, partner productivity, and forecast accuracy. Create joint business plans, partner scorecards, pipeline reviews, and quarterly business reviews that translate strategy into measurable action. Develop executive-level relationships with partners of different sizes, support priority opportunities, and hold partners accountable for forecasting, enablement, and results. Partner with Product Management, Marketing, Sales, Finance, Legal, and Commercial Operations to equip partners to sell Esko’s software portfolio, including new and acquired offerings. Define the systems, reporting, governance, and operating cadence required to scale a consistent global program and improve its economics over time. Demonstrated success recruiting and developing a meaningful partner ecosystem and growing channel-driven revenue; able to explain the regions covered, number and types of partners, program scale, time to impact, and revenue contribution. Hands-on expertise developing partner agreements, program tiers, economics, enablement, deal registration, forecasting, and rules of engagement with direct sales. Bachelor’s degree and professional fluency in English, with the ability to influence executives, partners, and cross-functional stakeholders across cultures and time zones. An established, relevant partner network or strong country-level knowledge of potential software partners in target regions. Proven experience consolidating and harmonizing disparate partner programs into a single, unified partner program. Our integrated platform and comprehensive tools empower retailers, pre-media and trade shops, manufacturers, and converters to manage best-in-class packaging design and print processes.
